Configuration

कॉन्फ़िग पुनर्स्थापना

The process of reinstating a previous configuration state from backup or snapshot, used to recover systems after configuration errors or failures in enterprise environments.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ITIL v4, AWS Well-Architected Framework, Kubernetes Documentation, CNCF and published by Protermify IT/DevOps as a static IT and DevOps reference page.

Definition

The process of reinstating a previous configuration state from backup or snapshot, used to recover systems after configuration errors or failures in enterprise environments.

Operational example

Config restore allows teams to quickly recover from faulty deployments by reverting to a previously validated configuration state.
